SELECT r.yr AS race_year, r.event_schedule->>'event_name' AS race_name,
  concat_ws(' ', d.driver_identity->'name'->>'first_name', d.driver_identity->'name'->>'surname') AS driver_name,
  (s.sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int AS podium_position,
  floor((to_date(r.event_schedule->>'date_set','YYYY/MM/DD') - (d.driver_identity->>'birth_date')::date) / 365.25)::int AS age_at_race
FROM sprint_results s JOIN races r ON r.rak_id = s.matchref JOIN drivers d ON d.drv_main = s.unitdrive
WHERE (s.sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int BETWEEN 1 AND 3
  AND floor((to_date(r.event_schedule->>'date_set','YYYY/MM/DD') - (d.driver_identity->>'birth_date')::date) / 365.25) >= 35
ORDER BY age_at_race DESC, race_year DESC

WITH c AS (SELECT cr.unitnode, COUNT(*) AS starts, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cr.st_mark IS NULL) AS finishes
  FROM constructor_results cr GROUP BY cr.unitnode)
SELECT k.namelabel AS constructor_name, c.starts AS races_started, c.finishes AS races_finished,
  c.finishes * 100.0 / c.starts AS reliability_rate,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.finishes * 100.0 / c.starts DESC) AS reliability_rank
FROM c JOIN constructors k ON k.cstr_key = c.unitnode
WHERE c.starts > 10
ORDER BY reliability_rate DESC

WITH per_race AS (SELECT wheel_unit, rc_index, STDDEV_POP(msec_val / 1000.0) AS ltc
  FROM lap_times GROUP BY wheel_unit, rc_index)
SELECT json_build_object('surname', d.driver_identity->'name'->>'surname', 'first_name', d.driver_identity->'name'->>'first_name') AS driver_name,
  AVG(p.ltc) AS avg_consistency, COUNT(DISTINCT p.rc_index) AS races_analyzed
FROM per_race p JOIN drivers d ON d.drv_main = p.wheel_unit
GROUP BY d.drv_main, d.driver_identity
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.rc_index) > 5
ORDER BY avg_consistency ASC

WITH h AS (SELECT ds.rlink AS race_id, ds.acc_pt, r.yr, r.rnum, to_date(r.event_schedule->>'date_set','YYYY/MM/DD') AS rdate, (d.driver_identity->>'birth_date')::date AS bdate
  FROM driver_standings ds JOIN races r ON r.rak_id = ds.rlink JOIN drivers d ON d.drv_main = ds.drive_link
  WHERE d.driver_identity->>'reference' = 'hamilton'),
p AS (SELECT race_id, rdate, bdate,
  acc_pt / ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY yr ORDER BY rnum) AS ppr FROM h)
SELECT race_id, ppr / floor((rdate - bdate) / 365.25) AS dpv FROM p ORDER BY race_id
